summary_en: EDION executed a block acquisition of 1,988,800 shares (1.88% of outstanding shares) on November 11, 2026 via ToSTNeT-3 at a fixed price of 2,514 yen per share, totaling approximately 5.0 billion yen, as part of a broader ASR program announced on November 5, 2026.
title_en: Notice Regarding Purchase of Treasury Stock through Off-Hours Trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief:
On November 10, 2026, EDION's Board of Directors decided to execute a block acquisition of treasury stock through off-hours trading (ToSTNeT-3). The company placed an order to purchase 1,988,800 shares at 2,514 yen per share on November 11, 2026, representing 1.9% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock. The total acquisition price was approximately 5.0 billion yen. The transaction was executed on November 11, 2026 at 8:45 a.m. through the Tokyo Stock Exchange's ToSTNeT-3 system.

This acquisition was announced as part of a broader accelerated share repurchase (ASR) program that EDION announced on November 5, 2026. Morgan Stanley MUFG Securities was expected to submit a sell order for 1,988,800 shares as the counterparty to the transaction. The company noted that the final number of shares acquired could fluctuate depending on post-execution adjustments to ensure the effective acquisition price aligns with a specified average price over a certain period.
